about: A day given its own title, then the whole series marked free in Google Calendar and polled: Google keeps the day's record busy and the day does not own its marking (Oshyan/better-cal#318, left to the 1.5.11 rebuild). x-own does not judge that day's marking while the series' marking was last changed in Google Calendar, and counts it as Not checked (#318); every other field of the day is judged.
